issue: PA Carian Umum blue cart button can be clicked while Troli Anda remains at 0 item
rootCause: v1253's table-cart click owner still lived inside azobss-pabm-storefront.js (an ES module). The PA results table can become interactive before that module finishes its Firebase/price-adjustment import chain, leaving the cart button temporarily without an effective owner. The early bridge only waited for the module and was not a real cart writer.
fix: Move immediate table cart ownership to classic azobss-pabm-early-bridge.js
Handle PA/BM/SBM/GPS/Syit table ADD and REMOVE synchronously in capture phase
Write the exact same azobss_pabm_store_cart_v1_<user> localStorage format used by storefront
Render Troli Anda count/items/total immediately without waiting for Firebase/module init
Make window.azobssAddToPaBmCart use immediate bridge fallback when storefront API is not ready
Prevent storefront from installing a duplicate table-click owner when early bridge is active
Keep storefront takeover for authoritative price adjustment and checkout after module init
Bump all PA/BM v1253 cache references to v1254 and stale global-auth dynamic import to v1254
